query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.list
query.sql:
select pt.id, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, pt.grade_levels, pt.priorityonly, pt.admin, pt.mustmeet, pt.capacity, to_char(pt.remarks) as remarks, pt.status, count(distinct ptc.id) as coursescount, count(distinct pts.id) as sectionscount, count(distinct ptu.id) as schoolstaffcount
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_courses ptc on pt.id = ptc.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_sections pts on pt.id = pts.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_schoolstaff ptu on pt.id = ptu.u_ptc5_timeslotsid
where pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and (:coursedcid = -1 or ptc.coursedcid = :coursedcid) and (:sectiondcid = -1 or pts.sectiondcid = :sectiondcid) and (:schoolstaffdcid = -1 or ptu.schoolstaffdcid = :schoolstaffdcid) and (:daterange1 is null or pt.startdt >= :daterange1) and (:daterange2 is null or pt.enddt <= :daterange2) and (:status = -1 or nvl(pt.status,0) = :status) and (:timeslotid = -1 or pt.id = :timeslotid)
group by pt.id, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, pt.grade_levels, pt.priorityonly, pt.admin, pt.mustmeet, pt.capacity, to_char(pt.remarks), pt.status
order by pt.startdt, pt.enddt

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.single
query.sql:
select pt.id, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, pt.grade_levels, pt.priorityonly, pt.admin, pt.mustmeet, pt.capacity, pt.remarks, pt.status
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt
where pt.id = :timeslotid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.single.courses
query.sql:
select ptc.id, ptc.coursedcid, c.course_name, c.course_number
from u_ptc5_timeslots_courses ptc inner join courses c on ptc.coursedcid = c.dcid
where ptc.u_ptc5_timeslotsid = :timeslotid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.single.sections
query.sql:
select pts.id, pts.sectiondcid, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, c.course_name
from u_ptc5_timeslots_sections pts inner join sections e on pts.sectiondcid = e.dcid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number
where pts.u_ptc5_timeslotsid = :timeslotid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.single.users
query.sql:
select distinct ptu.id, ptu.schoolstaffdcid, t.lastfirst
from u_ptc5_timeslots_schoolstaff ptu inner join teachers t on ptu.schoolstaffdcid = t.dcid
where ptu.u_ptc5_timeslotsid = :timeslotid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.blocked.list
query.sql:
select pt.id as timeslotid, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, ptb.id as blockid, ptb.schoolstaffdcid, t.lastfirst, ptb.requester, ptb.approver, ptb.status, ptb.remarks
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt inner join u_ptc5_timeslots_blocked ptb on pt.id = ptb.u_ptc5_timeslotsid inner join teachers t on ptb.schoolstaffdcid = t.dcid
where pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and nvl(pt.status,0) = 1 and (:daterange1 is null or pt.startdt >= :daterange1) and (:daterange2 is null or pt.enddt <= :daterange2) and (:schoolstaffdcid = -1 or ptb.schoolstaffdcid = :schoolstaffdcid) and (:status = -1 or ptb.status = :status) and (:blockid = -1 or ptb.id = :blockid)
order by pt.startdt, pt.enddt

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.timeslots.list.block
query.sql:
select pt.id as timeslotid, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, ptb.id as blockid, ptb.status, ptb.requester, ptb.approver, ptb.remarks
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_blocked ptb on pt.id = ptb.u_ptc5_timeslotsid and ptb.schoolstaffdcid = :schoolstaffdcid
where pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and nvl(pt.status,0) = 1 and (:daterange1 is null or pt.startdt >= :daterange1) and (:daterange2 is null or pt.enddt <= :daterange2) and (:timeslotid = '-1' or pt.id = :timeslotid)
order by pt.startdt, pt.enddt
